Name: Updated JSON files for Yellog Flower Dialogue UI (1.6)
Author: SEISHI112
Description:
A simple, content.json and manifest.json replacement for [url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10274527]Yellog Flower Dialogue UI[/url] by KAYA in SDV.

Steps are simple if you already have the original mod:
1. Download and extract my files inside of the "[CP] Yellog Flower Dialogue UI" folder.
2. Let the old files get replaced.
3. That's all!

[i]If for some reason you use [url=https://blog.naver.com/ssm4031/222130321865]IYAHO's Pink Dust Interface[/url] or [url=https://blog.naver.com/ssm4031/221847779070]IYAHO's Pink-Blue Interface[/url],[/i] the original mod used to disable itself when any of these were present in the Mods folder. Since these haven't been updated for 1.6, despite just needing a simple adjustment, I've removed the original mod's argument to disable itself when these interface replacements were in use.

[size=1][center]This "mod" DOES NOT contain KAYA's assets.
Its only intent is to slightly update the JSON files so that it may work as expected in the latest version.
Still, if she were to ask me to delete this, I would do as told.[/center][/size]
